items.title: Fossil leg bone found in 2009 reveals new extinct bird species 17 years later
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Researchers have identified a new extinct species of ground-dwelling bird, Megapodius rokusi, from a fossil. This fossil, a leg bone, was discovered in Liang Bua cave on Flores Island, Indonesia. It represents the first megapode fossil found in the region called Wallacea, indicating new insights into ancient bird species. The study suggests that the bird was much larger than today's living relatives.

items.author: NITESH DUBEY
items.description: With Shubman Gill and KL Rahul set to miss the final two games to prepare for the upcoming Test series, the spotlight now shifts to the batting combination Shreyas Iyer will field in the remaining matches. items.title: Anthropic targets $90 billion IPO at $1.4 trillion valuation
items.description: Anthropic PBC is preparing for an initial public offering aiming for a fully diluted valuation of $1.4 trillion. items.description: जम्मू-कश्मीर के गुलमर्ग में ताजा बर्फबारी हुई। गुलमर्ग गोंडोला के फेज-1 के आसपास के पहाड़ बर्फ की सफेद चादर से ढक गए। दिल्ली में AIIMS के आसपास सुबह 6:30 बजे एयर क्वालिटी इंडेक्स (AQI) 322 दर्ज किया गया, जो बहुत खराब श्रेणी में आता है। एयर क्वालिटी इंडेक्स (AQI) 201 से 300 तक होने पर हवा खराब मानी जाती है। 301 से 400 तक बहुत खराब और 401 से 500 गंभीर श्रेणी होती है। मध्य प्रदेश के 17 शहरों में न्यूनतम तापमान 15 डिग्री से नीचे पहुंच गया है। अमरकंटक और करौंदी में पारा 12 डिग्री से नीचे चल रहा है।…

items.title: How Michael Jackson's 1984 escape to Caribou Ranch inspired Neverland
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: At the height of his fame in 1984, Michael Jackson took a private break at Caribou Ranch in Colorado during The Jacksons' Victory Tour. Away from the crowds, cameras and constant attention, the singer enjoyed horseback riding, explored the Rocky Mountains on a three-wheeled Honda ATV and spent hours rehearsing his dance moves. The secluded recording studio offered him something he rarely experienced: the freedom to step outside without being surrounded by bodyguards.

items.title: Worker buys abandoned lottery ticket worth $12.8m; court allows ownership fight
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: Robert Gawlitza, a former Circle K manager, found himself in a legal battle after purchasing a winning lottery ticket worth nearly $12.8 million, which was supposedly left unpaid by a customer. Circle K argues that the ticket should never have been sold, while Gawlitza claims he adhered to store procedures. This ongoing case aims to clarify who rightfully owns the lucky ticket.
